correctness.rationale: The normalization H(z)=exp(-theta z)(1-z)^(-theta) yields the exact mixed factorial moments. Coefficient transfer through order n^(-2) proves theta^2(1-theta)n^(-2), uniform in fixed distinct lengths. At theta=1 the alternating-series remainder r_m is positive, r_(m+1)/r_m <=1/(m+1), and for N=n-a-b >=2 the signed linear determinant contribution is >=e^(-1)*(62/81)r_N while the opposing quadratic correction is <=(2/81)r_N^2. Boundaries N=0 and 1 are explicit. Stirling-free integral asymptotic r_N ~1/(N+1)! yields the signed factorial prefactor. Exact rational checker executed successfully with 4883 assertions, including complete derangement enumeration through n=8; finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: For all distinct short-cycle lengths, a common leading covariance coefficient reveals a nontrivial phase boundary of the Ewens parameter. At uniform permutations without fixed points, dependent cycle counts display strict alternating signs for every allowed finite size yet a factorially tiny magnitude, contrasting sharply with n^-2 behavior on either side and exact unconditioned uniform decorrelation. This is a natural full classification of a second-order feature of conditioned logarithmic assemblies, relevant to quantitative finite-size Poisson limits rather than an arbitrarily sliced computation.
